$comment: Demo/presentation metadata for Sarah. Everything here is deliberately NOT a snapshot field — signal-snapshot.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false at every level, so adding any of this to a snapshot would be a contract change.
$region_note: Region is an attribute of the subject ACCOUNT (data residency, consent stack, units, retailer set), not of a per-day signal payload. It must agree with the snapshot's timezone, and a test asserts that.
$activity_note: The thing the engine overrides. C2's strikethrough is load-bearing — the user has to see their own plan being changed, not a generic suggestion appearing.

$in_balance_note: Sarah reaches in_balance only by turning cycle tracking OFF. With it on she is structurally incapable of reaching it: Layer 2 covers cycle days 1-28 with no gaps and the engine defines calm as 'only always-on Layer 3 fired', so an L2 rule fires every single day. See app-states.json open question 'in-balance-unreachable-for-cycle-trackers'. The other obvious route — cycle_day 31, fixture F13 — is deliberately NOT used, because that path produces 'in balance today' while the whole hormonal layer silently did not evaluate.
